anchors.name: sota_ref_n8
anchors.derivation: Heilbronn triangle problem, unit square, n=8: minimum area (sqrt(13)-1)/36 = 0.07237642431844414 (computed directly from the closed form during this task's construction), proved optimal by L. Dehbi and Z. Zeng in 2022. Independently re-confirmed by direct fetch of Erich's Packing Center on 2026-09-06.

anchors.name: sota_ref_n10
anchors.derivation: Heilbronn triangle problem, unit square, n=10: best-known minimum area approx 0.04654 (decimal as given by the source; no closed form or proof of optimality is claimed for n>=10). Independently re-confirmed by direct fetch on 2026-09-06.

anchors.name: sota_ref_n11

anchors.name: sota_ref_n12
anchors.derivation: F. Comellas, J. L. A. Yebra, "New Lower Bounds for Heilbronn Numbers," Electron. J. Combin. 9 (2002), #R6, a computational lower bound found via simulated annealing. Cross-confirmed against Erich's Packing Center (n=12 listed as approx 0.03260, best-known only, not proven optimal), independently re-fetched on 2026-09-06.
